messages:
alex: Heads up — opened a PR that tightens RBAC for scan-service and CI is now failing on the SAST/DAST evidence upload step. Can someone triage before EOD? PR: https://git.redwood/infra/scan-service/pull/812

lina: Reproduced locally. PutObject to evidence bucket returns 403 from prow. Logs attached.

security-bot: [alert] SAST pipeline: stage=upload-evidence status=failed job=scan-run-812 artifacts=0x3a14

sam: Logs also show KMS errors: "AccessDeniedException: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/scan-service/... is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt"

jamie: That matches. The PR removed the temporary KMS grant path the uploader relied on. scan-service needs kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-efg scoped for the evidence bucket alias.

alex: Rolled back last commit locally and CI passes, but prow still failing — suspect ephemeral grant mapping missing in cluster role. Prow logs:
```
put_object error: PutObject AccessDenied: status code: 403, request id: 9f8c
kms decrypt denied for key id: abcd-efg principal: service/scan-uploader@redwood
```

priya: Two needs: (1) chain-of-custody so we can prove who uploaded artifacts, (2) a clearer approver flow for RBAC changes touching KMS/evidence stores. Current approvals are ad-hoc.

lina: Temp mitigation: add an ephemeral grant (flightdeck) for 2 hrs to unblock CI + post on #eng-sre and #eng-security. @sre-oncall can you approve?

sre-oncall: I can approve a 1h grant only. Prefer scoped policy exception, not a permanent change. What's the exact policy?

jamie: Proposed minimal policy snippet:
```
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-efg",
  "Condition": {
    "StringEquals": {"aws:PrincipalTag/role": "scan-service"}
  }
}
```

sam: Audit shows denied principal: `service/scan-uploader@redwood` which has tag role=scan-service — condition matches only if tag propagation present. The PR removed tag propagation in the helm chart.

priya: For review process: update premerge checklist to require (a) KMS resource review, (b) audithook correlation header `x-audit-request-id`, (c) uploader ownership and reviewer signoff. Also add playbook step to run `scan-evidence verify` before release.

alex: I'll open a follow-up PR to: (1) add scoped ephemeral exception, (2) restore tag propagation in helm values, (3) add audithook header and playbook step. Assigning reviewers @jamie and @priya.

lina: :thumbsup: If unresolved in 24h we should run a short postmortem and include chain-of-custody details (uploader identity, timestamp, artifact hash).

security-bot: [ticket created] SEC-3421: SAST pipeline failed during evidence upload; 12 findings needs-triage. Linked artifacts: s3://evidence/scan-run-812/*

alex: Adding triage notes to SEC-3421 with repro steps and stacktrace. Will attach PutObject sample and kube manifest diff.

sre-oncall: If this becomes an incident: capture binary provenance (signer, build-id) and include signer metadata so chain-of-custody can be verified.

priya: Also require logs to include `x-audit-request-id` and principal ARN in audithook for fast correlation. Without that we lose the thread between KMS logs and S3 PutObject.

alex: Thanks — will update with follow-up PR and mark ephemeral grant in flightdeck. Ping me if you need the grant now.
